note: 上級者版のモード定義。話題・場面は自由に追加・編集してよい。会話開始時に各リストからランダムに1つ選ぶ（直近に使ったものは避ける）。

modes.description_ja: 友人・同僚・初対面の相手との雑談。話題を広げる・切り替える力をつける。

personas.name: Alex
personas.description: a friendly American coworker in his thirties who loves food and travel

personas.name: Sophie
personas.description: a cheerful British friend in her late twenties who works in tech

personas.name: Daniel
personas.description: a laid-back Australian you just met at a party

personas.name: Maya
personas.description: a Canadian teacher you met at a conference, curious about Japan

topics: what you did last weekend
a recent trip or a place you want to visit
food you have been into lately
how work has been this week
a hobby you started recently
a movie, show, or book you enjoyed
new technology or gadgets you use every day
how AI tools are changing everyday life
the change of seasons and what you like to do in each one
living in a smaller city versus a big city
morning routines and habits
a funny or embarrassing thing that happened recently
plans for the end of the year
learning languages as an adult
the best advice you have ever received

modes.description_ja: 社会問題について、反対の立場のAIと議論する。英検1級の二次試験のような形式。

personas.name: Chris
personas.description: a sharp but fair debate partner

personas.name: Rachel
personas.description: a thoughtful journalist who likes to challenge ideas

topics: Will AI create more jobs than it destroys?
Should remote work become the standard for office jobs?
How should Japan respond to its aging population?
Should university education be free?
Should social media companies be more strictly regulated?
Is nuclear power necessary to fight climate change?
Is overtourism a serious problem, and how should it be managed?
Should companies adopt a four-day work week?
Is a completely cashless society desirable?
Should English education in Japan start at an earlier age?
Is it acceptable to use genetic engineering to prevent diseases?
Is government spending on space exploration justified?
Should cars be banned from city centers?
Is a universal basic income a realistic idea?
Should personal privacy be limited for the sake of public safety?

modes.description_ja: 仕事や生活の具体的な場面を演じる。途中で予想外の展開が1回入る。

scenes.scene: A short meeting in the teachers' room before class
scenes.ai_role: an ALT who has a different idea for today's lesson activity
scenes.user_role: a Japanese English teacher planning a team-taught lesson
scenes.goal: Agree on the lesson plan and who does what, while respecting the ALT's idea
scenes.complication: the ALT says the activity you planned did not work well in another class

scenes.title_ja: 国際学会の休憩時間の雑談
scenes.scene: A coffee break at an international education conference
scenes.ai_role: a teacher from another country you have just met
scenes.user_role: a teacher from Japan attending the conference
scenes.goal: Introduce yourself, find a common interest, and exchange contact information naturally
scenes.complication: the other person asks a tough question about Japanese education

scenes.title_ja: ホテルで苦情を伝える
scenes.scene: The front desk of a hotel abroad, late at night
scenes.ai_role: a tired but polite front desk clerk
scenes.user_role: a guest whose room has a broken air conditioner
scenes.goal: Get the problem fixed or get a room change tonight

scenes.scene: The customer service counter of an electronics store
scenes.ai_role: a store employee who follows the rules strictly
scenes.user_role: a customer returning headphones that stopped working
scenes.goal: Get a refund or an exchange
scenes.complication: you no longer have the receipt

scenes.title_ja: 日本の学校制度を説明する
scenes.scene: A casual dinner with a visitor from abroad
scenes.ai_role: a curious visitor who asks many follow-up questions
scenes.goal: Explain how Japanese high schools work, including club activities and university entrance
scenes.complication: the visitor compares it critically with their own country's system

scenes.title_ja: 英語を話す保護者との面談
scenes.scene: A parent-teacher meeting at a Japanese high school
scenes.ai_role: an English-speaking parent who is worried about their child
scenes.goal: Explain the situation clearly, listen to the parent's concerns, and agree on next steps
scenes.complication: the parent becomes a little emotional and asks for something the school cannot do

scenes.scene: An online job interview for a position at an international school
scenes.ai_role: an interviewer who asks behavioral questions
scenes.user_role: a candidate with experience teaching English in Japan
scenes.goal: Answer questions with concrete examples and ask one good question at the end
scenes.complication: the interviewer asks about a weakness and follows up on your answer

scenes.scene: A busy train station in central Japan
scenes.ai_role: a tourist who is in a hurry and slightly lost
scenes.user_role: a local person who offers to help
scenes.goal: Help the tourist get to the right platform and train
scenes.complication: the train the tourist wants has been delayed

scenes.title_ja: パーティーでの人脈づくり
scenes.scene: A networking party for people working in education technology
scenes.ai_role: a startup founder who talks fast and is a bit self-promoting
scenes.user_role: a teacher interested in AI tools for education
scenes.goal: Have a good conversation, share your own projects, and end the conversation politely
scenes.complication: the founder tries to sell you their product

scenes.title_ja: 頼みごとを丁寧に断る
scenes.scene: A colleague stops by your desk
scenes.ai_role: a friendly colleague who wants you to take on an extra task
scenes.user_role: a busy teacher who cannot take on more work right now
scenes.goal: Decline politely while keeping a good relationship, and offer an alternative if possible
scenes.complication: the colleague says no one else can do it

modes.description_ja: 短い質問に即答する。止まらずに返す力をつける。黙ったまま一定時間たつとアプリが [NEXT] を送る。
